description: The runner's own control (`tools/runner-control.mjs`) for the plans of point 8, played apart from the cases. `plan-claims-work-with-no-gate` fires `closed-but-open`, and the runner has to report nothing of it as written. It has to report each variant: over `_reference` without its `rule`, a case that passed, which only the PASSED rule reports when the case declares no rule; over `_two-rules`, a plan firing `closed-but-open` and then `open-but-closed`, a case that fired more than it declares, which only the rule that a case fires one rule alone reports; with `rule` set to `open-but-closed`, another rule.
